tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Continuity of the length of a vector field]

↗ lem:inner-product-vector-fields-smooth

1. ch2:2.2For smooth $X$ on a Riemannian manifold with or without boundary, the function $|X|=\langle X,X\rangle ^{1/2}$ is continuous.
Proof

↗ lem:inner-product-vector-fields-smooth \sketch The pairing is smooth and nonnegative by Lemma 4; compose it with the continuous square root on $[0,\infty )$.

□
